name: html-to-blocks
description: Agent workflows and MCP tools for content modeling, transforming designed HTML into editable WordPress blocks, and extracting installable block themes.

interface.shortDescription: Model content, transform designed HTML into editable WordPress blocks, and extract an installable block theme.
interface.longDescription: A staged WordPress design workflow. content-modeling decides posts, CPTs, taxonomies, meta, submission models, seed data, and generates an installable plugin to apply the model. html-to-blocks imports or generates high-quality HTML/CSS/JS mockups, plans core/custom WordPress blocks, assembles data-only block trees, and iterates with rendered/editor screenshot diffs. blocks-to-theme turns a completed run into an installable block theme: theme.json extracted from style evidence, template parts inferred from cross-page repetition, bundled fonts and media, generated plugins, and WordPress Playground verification against the mockups.
capabilities: CPT taxonomy and meta plugin generation
Rendered and editor visual diff loops
Block theme extraction with Playground verification
interface.defaultPrompt: Transform this designed or provided HTML into editable WordPress blocks with the html-to-blocks workflow.
